chapter: Clarinetists, brass bands and the day job
title: Big Eye and Picou as music readers
summary: Big Eye did not read music and Laurent helped him; Picou could read, though not brilliantly.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: I was going to ask some more about Big Eye. Did he ever help you any on the clarinet?
No, Big Eye Low didn't read any music. He didn't read? No, I could help him in line of music and stuff.
He was older than you, of course.
Yeah, Big Eye Low was like Fred's Domino. He played very well. He was a good executor. But he didn't know no at that time.
What about Piku? Was he much of a reader?
Yeah, Piku would read. Yeah, Piku would read. Yeah, Piku would read. But he wasn't all that great on reading, but he was a pretty good reader.
